# robotics-mcp — Robotics Control Server

MCP server for physical and virtual robots: Dreame vacuums, Yahboom ROS arms, Elegoo, Gazebo simulation, drone control, Philips Hue, and World Labs integration. FastMCP 3.2, dual transport: stdio + HTTP SSE on port 10706.

## Tools

- `robot_control` — Control any robot (Dreame, Yahboom, drone, Hue): get_status, start_cleaning, arm_move, gripper_control, takeoff, set_light_state
- `robot_navigation` — Navigation and path planning for mobile robots
- `robot_model_tools` — URDF, robot model management, kinematics
- `robot_manufacturing` — Manufacturing/assembly operations for robot arms
- `robot_camera` — Camera capture, stream, and image processing
- `robot_behavior` — Behavior tree and state machine management
- `robot_animation` — Robot animation sequences
- `robotics_system` — System diagnostics, health checks, ROS 2 node management
- `dreame_control` — Dreame D20 Pro vacuum: cleaning zones, schedules, dock
- `dreame_map_export` — Export Dreame LIDAR maps as floorplans
- `gazebo_models` — Gazebo simulation model management
- `drone_control` — PX4/ArduPilot drone: takeoff, waypoint, RTL
- `agentic_robotics` — Multi-step robot workflows via LLM sampling
- `agentic_support` — Agentic assist for planning robot operations
- `vbot_crud` — Virtual robot (vbot) lifecycle in Unity/VR
- `spz_converter` — SPZ (splat) file format conversion
- `cad_converter` — CAD model format conversion for robotics
- `sim_art_fleet` — Simulation art and asset fleet management
- `fab_art_fleet` — Fabrication art pipeline for robot parts
- `environmental_logistics` — Environmental sensor and logistics management
- `noetix_bumi` — Noetix Bumi robot arm control
- `hue_client` — Philips Hue Bridge Pro light control
- `workflow_management` — Workflow definitions for multi-step sequences
- `sim_orchestrator` — Simulation orchestration and registry
- `robot_virtual` — Virtual robot creation and configuration

## Config

- Port: 10706 (dashboard), dual transport stdio + HTTP
- Env: DREAME_MAP_URL, YAHBOOM_IP, GAZEBO_MASTER_URI
- Clients: Dreame Cloud, Yahboom ROS, Elegoo, Gazebo

See [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) for full tool reference.
